caption:
Every component that reads a Context re-renders when that Context's value changes. If fast-changing state (like input text) lives next to slow-changing state (user, theme), everything pays for every keystroke.

Fixes:
Keep input state local to the component that owns it.
Split contexts: one for user, one for theme.
Memoize the context value object.

React DevTools → Profiler → "Highlight updates" shows you exactly what re-renders.

Source: react.dev, useContext (optimizing re-renders).

altText:
A common React slowdown I see in code reviews:

one Context holds user, theme AND the search box text.

Type one letter → every component using that Context re-renders.
